pages.text: $(bold)$(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 19 - 62 °C$(br)$(bold)$(l:agriculture/growing_crops#hydration)Hydration$(): 10 - 100 %$(br2)Oil Palm trees are harvested for their fruits which can be processed into Palm Oil and a source of burlap fiber.
